explication: KitOps is a Go CLI for generating Kitfiles, packaging AI/ML project assets as OCI-based ModelKits or ModelPacks, and managing those artifacts locally or in registries. The principal workflow is to initialize or import project contents, pack them, push or pull a version, then inspect or selectively unpack it. The graph also includes documented listing, comparison, authentication, and skill-install capabilities. Relationships among unsampled command implementations are shown only where the README documents them; edges to external systems reflect documented product behavior.
